'''Jaadel the Vindicator''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Cathar/Legends|Cathar]] [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] living during or after the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]].<ref name="SWTOR" />

==Behind the scenes==
Jaadel the Vindicator was added to ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'' with [[Star Wars: The Old Republic: Knights of the Eternal Throne|''Knights of the Eternal Throne'']] expansion as a World Boss for Dark vs. Light system. Whenever [[Light side of the Force]] reaches victory state on a server, Jaadel the Vindicator has a chance to spawn at one or more of selected locations on [[Hoth/Legends|Hoth]] alongside other Light Side World Bosses. Though killing him is required for an in-game achievement, it is impossible the year when his [[Death/Legends|death]] took place.
